title: イングリッシュトピックス1
subtitle: English Topics 1
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In English Topics 1, students will acquire communication skills in English by studying various topics, English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. They will develop effective language learning techniques.
advice: The class will be conducted using the followings topics: Live Escalate Book 1 Unit 1 Meeting New People Unit 2 School Life Unit 3 Seeing a Doctor Unit 4 Expressing Yourself Unit 5 Getting Around Unit 6 Talking About the Time Unit 7 Eating Out Unit 8 At the Supermarket Each class consists of active learning activities such as pair work, group work, English games, and presentations. Before each class, students must check Moodle and the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class. Students should also bring a dictionary to every class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.

activityGoals.body: Listen and understand the overall content of the unit.
Understand the basic grammar, vocabulary and expressions in each unit and use them in simple sentences.
Understand and summarize the main points of the text and express them orally.
Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills.
Develop a habit of studying autonomously through online assignments.

achievementLevels.ideal: - Listen and understand the content of the unit perfectly. - Understand the basic English grammar, the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit, and use or apply them appropriately. - Understand and summarize the main points of each text and express them orally. - Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills. - Develop a habit of studying autonomously.
achievementLevels.standard: - Listen and understand the overall content of the unit. - Understand the basic English grammar, the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit, and, though not perfectly, use them to form simple sentences. - Understand the main points of each text and express them orally. - Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills. - Develop a habit of studying autonomously.
